# Nishant Unavane — Portfolio (2027 Edition)
> Full-Stack Developer & Agentic AI Systems Engineer based in Pune, India.

## About
Nishant Unavane builds interfaces, developer tools, coding agents, and the systems that connect them. His engineering focuses on full-stack web applications, VS Code extensions, and autonomous agent architectures built with Next.js, React 19, TypeScript, Three.js, Fastify, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling.

## Key Metrics
- 4+ VS Code extensions published
- 15+ projects shipped
- 2+ years professional software development
- 10,340+ community downloads across tools

## Flagship Projects
1. Custom-PI (https://custom-pi-ai.vercel.app / https://github.com/IamNishant51/Custom-PI)
   - Category: Coding agent / local-first platform
   - Description: A dual terminal and web platform for autonomous coding agents with persistent memory graph, multi-agent orchestration, browser automation, and MCP tool synthesis. 4,458 npm downloads.
2. Synapse (https://synapsememory.vercel.app / https://github.com/IamNishant51/Synapse)
   - Category: Memory / knowledge graph
   - Description: A Cognee-based cognitive memory dashboard engineered for continuous ingestion, entity conflict reconciliation, temporal state tracking, and 3D visual knowledge-graph traversal.
3. Carto (https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=nishantunavane.carto / https://github.com/IamNishant51/CARTO-VS-CODE-EXTENSION)
   - Category: VS Code context engine
   - Description: A production VS Code extension that digests an entire repository into structured, token-optimized Markdown context with file trees, architectural stack analysis, real-time diff preview, and LLM prompt generation.
4. Ollama Agent (https://github.com/IamNishant51/Ollama-Agent-vs-code-extension)
   - Category: VS Code / local models
   - Description: A local-first VS Code assistant featuring automatic local model discovery, real-time code streaming, workspace context injection, inline diff previews, automated test authoring, and zero telemetry egress.
